title: AI coding agents produce a lossless weight format and faster speculative-decoding kernels
summary: The study checks losslessness and measures speed on specified projections and serving configurations against comparison systems. Measured gains are hardware-, workload- and implementation-specific and do not establish broader speedups across models or deployments.
ai_technology: AI coding agents autonomously searched and implemented speculative-decoding algorithms, including a lossless 12-bit weight format and fused kernels.
organization: University of California, Berkeley; Princeton University; Stanford University; NVIDIA
